Start with the essentials

The earlier 5–8-hour estimate covers focused implementation, subject to checking the installed subscription app. This expanded visual concept is not a commitment to a full redesign within that time.

What this preview does and doesn’t prove

Current pages are saved public references from October 16, 2026, with live scripts, forms, and off-preview navigation removed. The original JavaScript mobile menu, carousels, and forms are omitted; fonts may differ.

The proposed account, cart, dates, payment methods, and subscription actions use sample data only. They demonstrate a possible experience, not verified app capabilities.

Copy, sample prices, terms, and supported controls need approval and account verification before implementation. SEO results require separate measurement.

SEO improvements to review

Use descriptive page titles, useful headings, clear internal links, and approved product information. The prototype is intentionally excluded from indexing; it cannot demonstrate ranking or sales gains.
